faq.title: F.A.Q
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Contact us by email!
faq.q1: Is the quality good enough to publish on Amazon?
faq.a1: Yes, generated texts are ready to publish on Amazon KDP or any platform. You can still customize the content anytime.
faq.q2: Does it work for both fiction AND non-fiction?
faq.a2: Absolutely. OneBookLab™ handles all book types: novels, short stories, how-to guides, essays, and more.
faq.q3: Do I need to know how to write?
faq.a3: No. The tool handles structuring and writing for you. Just define your theme and preferences.
faq.q4: Can I edit the generated text?
faq.a4: Yes, all content is fully editable. You maintain complete control over every sentence and chapter.
faq.a5: Absolutely. The tool is designed for everyone, including first-time authors. It guides you step by step from idea to publication.
faq.a6: Yes, OneBookLab™ receives regular updates and new features to continuously improve quality and user experience. Track changes via the changelog available once registered.
faq.a7: Yes. Each generation is 100% exclusive: the AI creates content from your brief and parameters. No text is copied or reused for other users.
faq.q8: What's the average length of a generated book?
faq.a8: A complete book generated with OneBookLab™ averages 10,000-45,000 words, depending on detail level, chapters, and sections. It can be a short ebook (40 pages) or a comprehensive work exceeding 100 pages (60,000+ words) based on your settings.
faq.q9: Is the subscription price locked in?
faq.a9: Yes. Your subscription rate stays fixed as long as it's active. New features will be added over time, which may slightly increase pricing for new subscribers.
faq.a10: Annual subscriptions are billed once upfront. You receive all credits immediately, and they remain available even after the subscription period ends.
faq.q11: What if I don't use my credits this month?
faq.a11: Credits never expire: they roll over month to month as long as your subscription is active. Create at your own pace, with zero pressure.
